title: Market shrank
evidence: Own revenue Q4→Q1 (DB): 8 of 12 SBUs grew — portfolio +63.1 Cr; only Nexa Steel (−82), Asphalt (−17), Commodities (−10), NXEL (−0.8) shrank.
National market grew (web): steel +15% CAGR, food/edible-oil imports +16%, telecom +4.3%.
verdict_note: Market did not shrink. The drop is share-loss (4 SBUs) + margin (8 SBUs), not a contracting market.

title: Competitor won on price/offer
evidence: Competitor price/offer recovered (oms.tblCompetitorPriceHeader+Row numAvgMarketOffer): Nexa Steel 172, Nexa Essentials 194, Cement 271 headers (2024-25).
Named leaders (web): Boral Steel ~30% steel, Madhumala edible oil, Nexaphone 45.6% telecom.
verdict_note: Competitor price/offer now in DB for Nexa Steel/Nexa Essentials. National competitor share now delivered (Nexa Steel, Nexa Readymix, Logistics); regional competitor volume (C2) is Not Applicable.

title: Sales team did not engage
evidence: Team was equipped: KPI targets exist (Nexa Essentials 32,194, Nexa Steel 5,753) and beat routes exist (Nexa Essentials 6,695).
622 dealers churned (Q4 buyers with zero Q1 orders).
Actual calls unverifiable: oms.tblViciDialApiCallLog last entry 28-Aug-2025.
verdict_note: Equipped but unverifiable. Actual cause of missing data: the CallLog call-center feed stopped 28-Aug-2025 — no Q1 call log exists in the DB.

title: Sales team instability
evidence: Attrition now measured (HR-system separation-master): 2,248 separations — 951 in 2026, 796 in 2025, 487 in 2024.
Headcount 19,008 (employee-master).
SBU plans self-report: Logistics needs 4 salesmen, Nexa Infotech replace/hire 4 KAM, Nexa Mediplex team abolished then rebuilt.
verdict_note: Attrition is real and rising (951 separations YTD 2026) — corroborates the self-reported instability.

title: Supply / service failure
evidence: Short-supply now quantified (oms.tblSalesOrderRow numUndeliveryValues, Q1): Nexa Steel 61.1 Cr, Nexa Readymix 42.7 Cr, Nexa Essentials 17.6 Cr ≈ 136.9 Cr undelivered.
Stock transactions 3.16M (wms.tblInventoryTransactionHeader) across 7 loss SBUs.
SBU notes: NXEL zero stock, Nexa Essentials RM shortage, Asphalt LC-bitumen, Commodities no LC approval, Nexa Steel BMRE shutdown.
verdict_note: Strongest cause, now quantified: ~123.6 Cr of orders short-supplied in Q1 (revenue scale, not loss).

title: Credit policy pushed dealers away
evidence: AR now pullable (fin GL 5288056): Nexa Essentials 261k rows, Nexa Steel 101k.
Nexa Infotech root cause: overdue receivables + credit restrictions; Nexa Jobs: DSO 60→45, concentration 26%.
verdict_note: AR data available. Actual cause of the remaining gap: the credit-BLOCKED customer list needs the prt.tblBusinessPartner credit-limit join (not yet pulled).

title: Product / quality issue
evidence: No quality complaint in any SBU root-cause note.
Complaints table (prt.tblSiteComplainInfo) has Nexa Readymix only.
verdict_note: No evidence in submitted plans or complaint data.

title: Margin-driven loss
evidence: Nexa Telecom GP −36.6%; Commodities 8.0%; Logistics 2.8%; Asphalt 5.2%.
Nexa Essentials + Nexa Steel = 33.84 Cr of the 63.08 Cr total loss.
CM% now computed and fixed cost pulled for all 12 SBUs (break-even in Q2 outlook).
verdict_note: Confirmed with full CM% + fixed-cost base (was GP-only).

title: Went silent in market
evidence: Marketing spend now pullable (fin GL 3998056): Nexa Essentials 5.21 Cr, Nexa Steel 5.71 Cr in Q1.
verdict_note: Q1 marketing spend available. Actual cause of the remaining gap: Q4→Q1 spend-change needs the Q4 GL pull (Q1 is available).
